silicon_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Bulk Modulus
silicon_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_potential_file_subtask_bm.name: Silicon Potential File for Bulk Modulus
silicon_potential_file_subtask_bm.description: Procure an appropriate ReaxFF potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

silicon_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: Silicon Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
silicon_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Silicon based on given simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure.

silicon_C11_subtask_bm.name: Silicon Elastic Constant C11 Calculation
silicon_C11_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_1 = ε_xx mode to the relaxed silicon structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress components from the relaxed configurations. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C11 of silicon in GPa units.
